errors.text_span: “生活工作类”与“生理活动类”动词
errors.evidence: The description introduces the categories '生活工作类' (life and work) and '生理活动类' (physiological activities) in the introductory sentence, which are not directly stated in the figure's main titles. The titles refer to '支配动词' (dominant verbs) and '承受动词' (patient verbs). This appears to be an interpretation based on the garbled figure caption below the image.

The description incorrectly identifies two of the four x-axis categories. It lists '报刊' (Newspaper/periodical) instead of '新闻' (News), and '网络文学' (Online Literature) instead of '传统文学' (Traditional Literature).

The description completely omits the fact that for each category on the x-axis (e.g., '新闻'), there are two separate bars representing '女性' (Female) and '男性' (Male). This is a critical structural aspect of the chart.

The entire legend description is fabricated. The actual legends in the figure contain different semantic categories, such as '赠与', '索取', '言说' for chart (a) and '参与', '经历', '状态' for chart (b). The categories listed in the description do not appear anywhere in the image.

errors.text_span: “网络小说”类别最高, ... 其堆叠部分中“工作（2）”占比最大（约30%），其次为“生活（1）”（约20%）
errors.evidence: The description of the composition for the '网络小说' bar in chart (a) is incorrect. The image shows the tallest bar in this category (male) has a single dominant segment that accounts for 92% of the total, not 30% and 20% for different categories.
In chart (a), the '传统文学' (Traditional Literature) category has the lowest total frequency (16+186=202), not '报刊' (News), which has a total frequency of 469+4356=4825.
The description claims the total frequency for the '报刊' (News) category in chart (a) is about 1000. The actual total is 4825 (469 + 4356).

errors.text_span: 在图(b)中，各语体柱状图高度普遍较低，其中“微博”类别最高，总频次约为3000
errors.evidence: This statement is incorrect. In chart (b), the '网络小说' (Online Fiction) category has the highest bar by a large margin (value 5738), not '微博' (Weibo), which has one of the lowest frequencies (total of 14).
In chart (b), the '微博' (Weibo) category has the lowest total frequency (14). The '报刊' (News) category has a total frequency of 502 (23+479).
